evidence: The frozen workbook Quality Checks row 43 requires that weights/gates/criteria do not invert app quality; Internal E43 says this needs monitoring. Source inspection supports monotone arithmetic, but required empirical app ranking is absent. Frozen task/tests/scoring.toml:1-11 uses zero-mass gates, functional/polish/visual shares 0.6/0.2/0.2 and functional floor 0.05; tests/tools/score.py:40-48 checks gates, takes a positive weighted sum and zeroes rewards below the strict floor. Increasing an already-recorded outcome cannot decrease that arithmetic result. Both files match the frozen template byte-for-byte (SHA256 scorer 13de2b3885967e22aa13ded3bf33c354e3e741e85be871612c04e996eef5c04e; policy 95f70d6e06aae5e765b2309d88c444aa36d4cd82763ea2212781b6a99311bbba). All 79 functional criterion weights are positive (sum 32.85), as are six Polish and six Visual weights. The source challenge of a polished hardcoded-output/localStorage-only app is rejected by gates/render/judge.toml:25 and gates/constraints/judge.toml:25-29, requiring new authored output and independent-context server readback. A conforming app with native styling, server-rendered records, different control labels, or missing optional Auto-run setup is not rejected solely for those choices (gates/constraints/judge.toml:27; gates/render/judge.toml:27; tests/app_context.md:16; visual/judge.toml:40,55,85). These are source checks, not observed rankings. The indexed raw scorer probe explicitly fabricates dimension inputs (probe.py:13-31), records configured_judge_invoked=false, and demonstrates only arithmetic: gate failure and functional=0.05 return 0; (F,P,V)=(0.06,1,1) returns 0.436; (1,0,0) returns 0.6. Its observations SHA256 is 5fb27651dcb7713e2e943c11f2c56ec4d892d9777f34f55eae036916098379e6, with scorer/policy hashes matching current frozen bytes. Current golden RESULTS.json (SHA256 50b312418cb362cab6d085c78f777b1be8b25ab4948ded40b672b744de620d7b) records direct pinned Playwright, paid_provider=false and oracle_score_claimed=false; its successful scripted run is not a configured stronger/weaker-app comparison. I verified all 102 current_golden and 43 unchanged_scorer_arithmetic_controls artifact hashes against the current index. raw-evidence-index.json (SHA256 a6ec924aa6d761bf6535c59ffc5f99e1845e336acca876aae3583b25c71fd392) explicitly lists Empirical configured reward floor/ranking under not_measured, and this run has no runtime-evidence.json.
